conflicts: 7p 2P1/2 hyperfine splitting: Ranjit et al. 2014 give 2173.3(8) MHz (205Tl) and 2153.2(7) MHz (203Tl), 20 MHz above Grexa et al. 1988 (2155.5(6), 2134.6(8)); the newer two-step measurement is used. The other 1988 values kept here (7p3/2, 9p) may share the same calibration problem.
1283 nm E2/M1 amplitude ratio chi: 0.2550(20)(7) (Chen et al. 2023, EIT) versus 0.2387(10)(38) (Majumder & Tsai 1999) and 0.240(2) (Vetter et al. 1995).

7p lifetimes: direct measurements 63.1(1.7)/48.6(1.3) ns (James et al. 1986) and 61.9/48.4 ns +-2% (James et al. 1985) versus 60.21(55)/46.44(42) ns derived from the 6p1/2-7s Stark shift plus theory (Safronova & Majumder 2013).
8p 2P3/2 lifetime: 127.7(4.9) ns (James et al. 1986) versus 109(12) ns derived from A(8P3/2 -> all) = 9.2(1.0)e6 s^-1 (Hunter et al. 1982).
7s lifetime: 7.45(20), 7.6(2), 7.4(3), 7.7(5) ns from four measurements (mutually consistent).
7s-8p1/2 theory rate (1.755e6 s^-1) is half the measured 3.7(4)e6 s^-1 (Alonso-Medina 1997); 7s-8p3/2 theory 4.09e6 vs measured 6.2(6)e6.
not_found: Lande g_J factors (measured) for any Tl I level: NIST ASD lists none; no source opened.

6p 2P3/2 - 7s 2S1/2 (535 nm) centre-of-gravity frequency and isotope shift: Shie et al., Phys. Rev. A 88, 062513 (2013) abstract opened (accuracy 22 MHz) but it prints no numbers; full text not accessible.
6p 2P3/2 hyperfine constant of 203Tl and the original Gould (1956) paper: APS page has no abstract.
Isotope shift of the 1283 nm M1 line and of the 352 nm 6p3/2-6d5/2 line: not located.
Measured lifetimes of 6d 2D5/2, 8s 2S1/2, 7d 2D3/2,5/2: not located (NIST A values exist).
Hermann et al. 1993 (Z. Phys. D 28, 127) and Grexa et al. 1988 originals: publisher pages blocked; values quoted second-hand from Safronova et al. 2005 Table XII.
Hyperfine constants of 203Tl for 7p3/2, 6d, 7d, 8s, 9s, 9p: not in the opened sources.
notes: I(203Tl) = I(205Tl) = 1/2, so there are no B constants; for J=1/2 levels the hyperfine splitting equals A, for J=3/2 it equals 2A. rme_J_ea0 is |<J||D||J'>| in e*a0 in the Safronova convention A = 2.02613e18 S /((2J'+1) lambda^3[A]) with S = rme^2 (J' = upper level), identical to the schema convention. Entries marked compilation with "Table IV, column Z(expt)" are experimental matrix elements as collected by Kozlov, Porsev, Johnson 2001 and quoted by Safronova et al. 2005. The 7s-7p matrix elements and 7p lifetimes labelled derived come from the measured 378 nm Stark shift combined with theory (Safronova & Majumder 2013). Isotope shifts follow the SCHEMA convention nu(first)-nu(second) where the sign could be verified (378 nm: 205Tl higher); for the IR/red second-step transitions only the magnitude is certain. Extra fields beyond SCHEMA.md: hyperfine_component_frequencies_MHz, hyperfine_component_frequency_MHz, E2_M1_amplitude_ratio, PNC_E1_over_M1, A_E2_s, stark_shift_kHz_per_kVcm2, ionization_energy, mu_N. The UDel portal has no neutral Tl entry (only Tl+); neutral-atom theory comes from the Safronova-group papers.
